incidents.name: JokInTheBox staking unstake replay
incidents.notes: JokInTheBox staking's unstake(stakeIndex) paid out principal plus lock-period bonus without clearing or marking the stake record, so the same index 0 could be unstaked repeatedly until the contract's JOK balance was exhausted.

sources.ref: onchain review: staking contract 0xA6447f6156EFfD23EC3b57d5edD978349E4e192d created 2024-05-15T10:26:35Z by 0x9d438a53b2e4e9d453331da806ec4ae31eba1a0a, not the attack-tx sender 0xfcd4acbc55df53fbc4c9d275e3495b490635f113; no EIP-1967 events, 26.6 days old. The PoC loops unstake(0) until it reverts, confirming the stake record is never consumed. ~9.2 ETH at a June 2024 ETH price near $3,600 is roughly $33k. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 9.2 ETH x $3,666.27 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $33,730.
